recommendations.title: Infrastructure preinstall missing for scenario 'customer-A-istio'
recommendations.detail:
Failure message: sidecar injection enabled but pod stuck in PodInitializing.
kubectl -n sample describe pod sample-... shows istio-init container
waiting on CNI config — istio-cni-node not installed.
Assert 'pods-ready': 0/1 pods Ready after 5m0s.
sample-7d4f8c9b8-x7k2p: PodInitializing (istio-init waiting)
REPRO: helm install sample ./chart -n sample --set podAnnotations."sidecar\.istio\.io/inject"=true
recommendations.fix_prompt:
# Fix Recommendation: customer-A-istio

**Scenario:** `customer-A-istio`
**Category:** infrastructure
**Failure type:** pods-ready
**Affected objects:** Pod

## Failure Detail

Failure message: sidecar injection enabled but pod stuck in PodInitializing.
kubectl -n sample describe pod sample-... shows istio-init container
waiting on CNI config — istio-cni-node not installed.
Assert 'pods-ready': 0/1 pods Ready after 5m0s.
sample-7d4f8c9b8-x7k2p: PodInitializing (istio-init waiting)
REPRO: helm install sample ./chart -n sample --set podAnnotations."sidecar\.istio\.io/inject"=true

## Suggested Fix

The scenario requires an infrastructure preinstall (CNI, proxy, or network plugin). Add the required preinstall to the scenario YAML under `cluster.preinstall`, or ensure the cluster has the required networking plugin installed before running the scenario.

**Chart path:** `examples/sample-product-chart/chart`
**Only modify files under `examples/sample-product-chart/chart/`.**
